page.overview:
Who is Marks Family?

Marks's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Devon Blaine Marks from The New Kid, the third story of Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM.

Devon Blaine Marks is the main protagonist of the third Fazbear Frights book's third story.

Mrs. Marks is Devon's mother. She is tall and skinny with short, mussed dark hair, brown eyes with circles under them, and thin lips. Mrs. Marks is a house cleaner.

Mr. Marks is Devon's father. All Devon remembers about his was that he was abusive towards him and Devon's mother, throwing things at them. He eventually left her and Devon when he was three, leaving Devon to live with his mom.
